content.title: About
content.content: Hot chocolate (cocoa) with whipped cream is a beverage made from cocoa powder, sugar, milk or water, topped with a light, airy whipped cream. It offers a rich chocolate flavor, sweet creamy notes, and the comforting aroma of a warm drink on a cold day.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Cocoa powder is produced from fermented, dried, and roasted cacao beans.
The tradition of adding whipped cream to hot chocolate began in Europe in the 19th century.
In some countries hot chocolate is served with cinnamon, vanilla, or a pinch of sea salt.
Cocoa is rich in flavonoids, which give the drink its dark color and slight bitterness.
Whipped cream is made by beating fresh cream until soft peaks form, sometimes with added sugar or vanilla.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa contains flavonoids that help combat free radicals and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Cocoa stimulates the production of serotonin and endorphins, which can improve mood and reduce stress.

items.title: Source of magnesium
items.content: Magnesium in cocoa is important for muscle and nerve function as well as energy metabolism.

items.title: Calcium from cream
items.content: Whipped cream adds calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: The combination of sugars and the fats from cream provides a quick and sustained energy lift.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Large amounts of sugar can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of tooth decay.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort from the milk and cream.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Whipped cream can trigger allergic reactions in individuals allergic to milk proteins.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Cocoa contains small amounts of caffeine and theobromine, which may affect sleep if consumed in large quantities.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve hot chocolate with whipped cream in a mug, usually while hot. You can add a pinch of cinnamon, a dash of vanilla extract, or marshmallows. Apply the whipped cream just before serving to keep its airy texture.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store cocoa powder in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct light. Keep cream refrigerated and use within a few days after whipping. Do not leave the prepared drink at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
